Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The umpires and the fielders are in the middle. Aaron Finch and David Warner are set to open the innings for Australia. Dushmantha Chameera to start proceedings with the ball for Sri Lanka.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then, 300 on the board and a few quality spinners in their ranks means that at the halfway mark, the hosts have the upper hand. But Australia are a world-class side and if they get going from the start, the total wouldn't seem that big. It remains to be seen if the visitors are able to dominate the Lankan spinners. Stay tuned for the exciting run chase.

The start and the finish from Australia was disappointing but they did play some good cricket in between that. No wickets with the new ball and the opposition batters were all over the Aussies. The run-out affected by Marcus Stoinis was the turning point for the visitors as after that Ashton Agar was able to pick up wickets and squeeze the opposition as well. But the lack of someone like Adam Zampa in the middle overs did have an impact and it was then part-timer Marnus Labuschagne who got a couple of wickets. Jhye Richardson was given a hammering in the end and the fielding, in general, was below Australia's usual standard and they now have a stiff target to chase down.

The Lankan innings was set up nicely at the start as Danushka Gunathilaka and Pathum Nissanka added on 115 runs for the first wicket with twin half-centuries before an error in judgment broke that stand. Soon, both openers were dismissed and the hosts were a bit on the back foot. It was then a very steady partnership between Kusal Mendis and Charith Asalanka worth 77 runs that put Sri Lanka back in command. Wickets fell towards the end but Mendis kept on finding the fence and finished on 86 not out. But it was the blistering 19-ball 37 by Wanindu Hasaranga that have might just made a huge difference in the outcome of the game.

A scintillating cameo from Wanindu Hasaranga has propelled the hosts to a mammoth total of 300. Russel Arnold mentioned in his pitch report that it is a 250-260 run pitch but the hosts have surpassed that mark by quite a fair bit and will be fairly happy with the total on the board. Seeing this batting performance, they will be full of confidence going into the break, and also, generally, when Sri Lanka score 270 plus batting first against Australia, they end up on the winning side.

OUT! TAKEN! Straight to the man! A wicket on the last ball but a splendid knock from Wanindu Hasaranga! He loooks to play the paddle scoop but this is very full and on middle, he hits it but straight to short fine leg. The fielder takes an easy catch. Sri Lanka END WITH 300!
Commentary.Howout: c Jhye Richardson b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Carved away! Wanindu Hasaranga is dealing in boundaries! A full toss outside off, this is carved through point for a boundary. 300 up for Lanka.
A BYE! Outstanding last over from Hazlewood so far! A yorker outside off. Mendis looks to swing but misses. It goes behind to the keeper for one. Bye ran.
Really well bowled! Sees the batter make room and bowls a yorker outside off. Mendis lets it be as it is out of his reach,
Another full toss but only one as Wanindu Hasaranga hits it to mid off.
A single to start the last over! On off, this is pushed towards mid off for one.
Two more! Another overthrow! Outside off, this is carved through point. The take one. The fielder there dives to his right and stops it. Has a needless shy. No one backing up. A single taken.

FOUR! Guided away. Wonderful stroke! Five in a row now. Lanka can easily go past 300 now. Wanindu Hasaranga is playing with the field! All the fielders was got up on the off side. Wanindu Hasaranga makes room and carves it over point for a boundary.

FOUR! Four in a row and Hasaranga's cameo is taking the game away from the visitors! Poor bowling especially with third man and short leg up, one can't bang it so short. It is outide off, Wanindu Hasaranga carves it over point for a boundary.

FOUR! That is yet another poor effort in the field from Marnus! Really poor! A short slower one outside off, this is cut over point. Labuschagne in the deep, runs to his left, he slides early and lets the ball through.
FOUR! Up and over! Shorter and on middle, this is slammed down the ground, over the bowler's head for a boundary. Two in a row. 300 now possible.
FOUR! Nice and fine! That is very clever batting! Shorter and around off, Wanindu Hasaranga waits and then guides it past the keeper, very fine on the off side for a boundary.
Jhye Richardson comes back into the attack to bowl the penultimate over of the innings.
A full toss to end, Wanindu Hasaranga carves it through point for one. A really good over from Josh Hazlewood!
Two more! On middle, this is hit down to long on for a couple. No boundary in the over, can Hazlewoo end it well?
Hasaranga misses out there! A full toss, he heaves it but it goes more off the splice towards deep mid-wicket for two.
A dot now! Full and outside off, Wanindu Hasaranga looks to go over covers but misses.
Shorter, this one hurries the batter. Mendis mistimes it down to long on for one.
Around off, this is guided to point for only one. Singles won't harm the Aussies right now.
Josh Hazlewood comes back into the attack, probably to bowl the 48th and 50th overs.
A single to end! On the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
Overthrow! On off, this is slapped through point. They take one. The fielder in the deep hits the stumps at the keeper's end. It deflects away from the fielder backing up. Another run taken.
Finds the fielder! Shorter and outside off, this is cut hard but to the man at point.
Another slower one outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Another slower one, into the surface, this is guided down to third man for one.
Wanindu Hasaranga comes out to bat at number 8.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! That is massive turn! This is tossed up around off, it lands and spins away. Marnus Labuschagne looks to defend but gets an outside edge which is taken by the keeper. Wickets is the only way Australia can keep Sri Lanka under 285.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Marnus Labuschagne

Commentary.Commentary: BEATEN! That is a beauty! Tossed up on off, this lands and turns away. Chamika Karunaratne looks to defend but is beaten.
Shorter and outside off, this is cut to point for one.
FOUR! Make that two in a row! Tossed up outside off, this is dragged wide of the mid-wicket fielder again, to his left this time. Mendis is playing a gem.
FOUR! Consectutive boundaries! On middle, Mendis hammers the sweep through square leg for a boundary.
FOUR!The last ball spoils the over a little. Still though it is a brilliant over! Short and on middle, this is pulled wide of square leg for a boundary.
Yet another dot! Can Cummins end the over well? He has been brilliant so far! Shorter and around off, a slower one. Chamika Karunaratne chops it to covers.
Just the one! really good over so far! Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Good length and on off, Mendis pushes this to covers.
A slower one on middle, Mendis blocks it out.
Angled into the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
Good running. Flatter, around off. This is punched towards covers by Chamika Karunaratne for a quick single.
Length, around off and turning away. This is pushed through covers for a run.
Around off, driven through mid off for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! Brilliant catch in the deep but Dasun Shanaka will be so disappointed with that. A rank full toss, around off. Shanka dances down the track and completely mistimes the big shot. The ball goes over mid on but well in front of long on. David Warner runs in quickly and dives in front to hold on to a superb catch. Marnus Labuschagne with the golden arm and he has got rid of the dangerman. Also, Chamika Karunaratne is the new man in.
Commentary.Howout: c David Warner b Marnus Labuschagne

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, slower and around off. Shanaka looks to sweep against the turn but gets hit on the pads.
'Catch,' is the call but it will fall short. A low full toss, on off. Mendis sweeps it off the top edge towards deep backward square leg for a single.
On middle, this is swept away to deep mid-wicket for one. 13 off the over, a good one for Sri Lanka.
FOUR! Delicately played by Kusal Mendis. Flatter delivery, on off. Mendis backs away and cuts it very late, almost off the keeper's gloves and runs it down into the third man fence.
On off, worked towards mid-wicket.
Beaten! On a length, angling across the right-hander. Mendis looks to nudge it down to third man but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Flatter this time, around off, Mendis shuffles and paddles it fine. He picks up a couple of runs.
SIX! BANG! That made a cracking sound off the willow! Flighted, around leg stump. Kusal Mendis steps out and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a huge hit.
Around off, driven once again but it is well stopped at extra cover this time.
FOUR! Overpitcvhed this time from Marnus Labuschagne and Shanaka has creamed it through extra cover for a boundary.
Floated up, around off. This is driven straight towards extra cover.

Around off and turning away, Kusal Mendis goes for the expansive drive but gets an outside edge towards short third man. Pat Cummins over there does well to get down to his left and keep it down to a single.
Fuller, around off and turning away. Mendis has a thrash at it with the spin but finds the fielder at cover.
Starts off with a flatter delivery on off. Dasun Shanaka works it in front of square on the leg side for one.
Short again, around leg stump. Mendis can't get it through on the leg side.
Just a tad short and on the pads, Mendis dabs it down towards square leg.
Poor delivery but good piece of fielding. Down the leg side, Kusal Mendis gets low and pulls it hard to the right of fine leg. The fielder over there puts in the dive and saves a couple of runs.
Quicker, on middle and leg. Mendis defends it out off the back foot.
FOUR! Drifting down the leg side, Mendis gets a fine tickle on it and gets it past the keeper. The ball runs away into the fine leg fence.
Shorter and around middle, Mendis looks to pull but does so straight towards mid-wicket.
Powerplay 2 is done! The fielding team can now have up to 5 fielders outside the 30-yard circle.
Another fumble in the field and that will be FIFTY for Kusal Mendis, a very gritty knock from him. Shorter and outside off, cut away past the point fielder for a run.
There's a big roar from the crowd as the skipper gets off the mark. Angled into middle and leg, flicked away towards deep square leg for a single.
Good-length, around off. Mendis plays it off the back foot past backward point for a run.
Dasun Shanaka, the Sri Lankan skipper is in next.

OUT! TAKEN! Big, big breakthrough for Australia and Charith Asalanka has given it away. Jhye Richardson shortens his length and bowls it over middle. Asalanka looks to take it on and lift it over mid on but it's a bit too short for that. Asalanka ends up skying it just over mid on where Aaron Finch takes a solid catch running back. Could this be the wicket that turns the tide?
Commentary.Howout: c Aaron Finch b Jhye Richardson

Commentary.Commentary: Misfield and four! Around the hips, tucked away to the right of fine leg and the batters straight away look for two. Pat Cummins on the fence has a look up and takes his eyes off the ball and ends up spilling it as the ball goes into the fence.
Length ball, around the fifth stump line, this is played towards third man for a single.
A dot to end! Around the top of off, dabbed down towards backward point.
Pitched a bit further up and on off, Asalanka blocks it out.
WIDE! Attempted slower short ball, spilled well down the leg side.
Smart batting, just rotating the strike after the boundary. Good-length, around off, steered down to third man for one.
FOUR! A rare loosener from Josh Hazlewood. Length but too straight, Mendis shuffles a bit and pulls it past square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length, angled across off. Asalanka taps it past a diving backward point for a run. 200 up now for Sri Lanka and they are set up nicely for a big finish.
Short of a length, over middle. Mendis pulls it down to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Edgy boundary! Banged in short and over leg stump, Charith Asalanka looks to take it on but gets hurried on. The ball flies off the top edge and over the keeper's head for a boundary.
This is pushed a bit wider, Mendis waits on it and glides it towards third man for yet another single.
On the pads, worked away past square leg for a single.
WIDE! Full and wide, this is spilled beyond the tramline outside off, wided.
Attempted bouncer, bowled at a good height but seems to be down leg. Asalanka lets it go but no wide is called.
Length, around that fourth stump line. Mendis backs away and cuts it down to third man for one.
Richardson goes a bit wide of the crease and angles it in from outside off. Kusal Mendis blocks it out solidly.
Kusal Mendis will feel he could have done better there. Down the leg side but just a bit slower in pace. Mendis swivels but mistimes the pull down to fine leg for just a single.
On a length and slanted across the left-hander, Asalanka just steers it past backward point and picks up a run.
A bit of aggression shown here by Asalanka. Banged in short and around off, Asalanka steps out and mistimes the pull shot towards mid off.
Missed opportunity! Short and just outside off, Asalanka rocks back and cuts it straight to the man at backward point.
A touch fuller and on off, Asalanka defends it off the front foot towards extra cover.
Good-length, around off. Mendis plays it late and down towards third man for an easy single.
Josh Hazlewood is brought back into the attack for his third spell of the day.
Another easy run as this is worked with the angle down to fine leg.
On off, Mendis plays it to point.
Another single! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
From around the wicket, this is on a length and around off, it is guided to point.
Charith Asalanka has hurt himself a bit with the dive he put in last delivery and the physio is out with the magic spray. Asalanka seems fine and ready to go.
That is brilliant running! 50-run stand up too! On the pads, this is worked through square leg. They take the first run quickly and go for the second. Complete it.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Jhye Richardson (4-0-21-0) is back on.
Two more! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for two.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
BEATEN! Flatter and around off, angling away. Mendis looks to guide it down to third man but is beaten.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! That is a lovely shot! The shackles are probably broken after the last over. On middle, this is swept through square leg. Boundary.
Two more! Another poor effort in the field! Shorter and outside off, this is guided down to third man. The fielder slips which enables two.
Two more! Short again and on the body, this is pulled through mid-wicket for two. The fumble in the deep helps the batter take two.
FOUR! Nice and fine! Superb shot! Short and on the body, this is pulled fine on the leg side. A welcome boundary. A poor ball and put away nicely.
Just short! A superb stop in the end! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled towards deep square leg. Stoinis runs in and dives forward, it lands in front of him. He stops it well. A run only.
Slower one and on off, Charith Asalanka defends it on the off side.
Shorter and on off, Mendis guides it down to third man and takes one.
Top edge but safe! Shorter and on middle, Mendis looks to pull, this goes off the top edge but lands safe in the fine leg region. Only one.
Outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
Flatter and on off, defended.
Carey probably thought there was only pad there! On middle, Charith Asalanka looks to play the paddle sweep but he gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled towards deep square leg for one.
Almost! Flatter and outside off, Mendis looks to guide it down to third man but is beaten.

DRINKS! After a sedate start, Australia have managed to pick up three wickets and that too in quick time but Kusal Mendis and Charith Asalanka are doing a good job of keeping the scoreboard ticking. Ashton Agar has been the pick of the bowlers but is done with his spell. With pace proving ineffective so far, it will be interesting to see how the Aussie quicks use their variations. Sri Lanka are in a position of promise but a couple of wickets here and all the hard work will be undone.

Direct hit and Mendis was a goner! On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket. They go for one. Maxwell picks the ball up, turns and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. He needed to hit that. Tidy comeback from Cummins.
On off, Mendis cuts but to point.
Shorter and on the body, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Angled into the pads, Mendis works it through square leg for one.
Length and on off, Mendis looks to go over the off side but it goes off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Another dot! On off, this is guided to point.
Quicker and flatter, close to the off pole. Charith Asalanka guides it late but straight towards backward point.
Flatter this time, around middle. Asalanka plays it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, on off, this is pushed towards cover.
Maxwell seems interested but that's all it is. This is angled into middle and leg, just going on with the arm. Asalanka doesn't read it and gets pinged on the pads. Probably sliding down leg.
FOUR! Nicely done! Shorter in length, around off and turning away. Charith Asalanka waits for it and at the last moment just steers it fine into the third man fence.
WIDE! This is fired in but down the leg side, wide called.
Looks for the single but is sent back. Quicker one, around off, dabbed down towards point by Charith Asalanka.
End of Agar's spell and he finishes with figures of, 10-0-49-2! On the pads, this is turned through square leg for a single.
A bit quicker and angled into the stumps, Asalanka blocks it out.

Caught in two minds but survives! Kusal Mendis looks to use his feet and Ashton Agar just slows it up. Mendis ends up playing a checked lofted drive that goes on the bounce to long off. They get a run.
Fuller, around middle and leg. Charith Asalanka just drives it down to long on and picks up a single.
Good running! Around off, pushed away towards cover for a quick single by Mendis.
On a length, around middle and leg. This is worked through mid-wicket. The batters look for two but it will only be a single.

The umpires in the middle are having a chat. Actually, they have gone upstairs to review if there was an obstruction of field. The replay shows that Kusal Mendis did change his line but was just avoiding the throw on the previous delivery and was well in.

NOT OUT! There was a late appeal for an obstruction of the field! The ball did hit Mendis and he did change direction but he had made his ground. Quite an eventful ball there. First there was a tremendous effort from Marnus Labuschagne! The short ball is pulled towards his right. He runs to his right, slides but fails to take the catch. The ball is trickling over the ropes but he shows gret awarness to push it back in as he is falling onto the ground. The batters go for two. Marnus Labuschagne picks the ball up and throws it to the keeper. The ball hits Mendis. There is a question asked for obstruction of the field but Mendis had made his ground.
Another dot! On off, this is played back to the bowler.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to mid on for a single.
Tosses it up on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Flatter and on off, this is slapped towards cover where the fielder dives and stops it.
On the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for two.
FOUR! Swept and done so nicely! On the pads, this is hit through square leg and the ball races away to the fence. The over ends in a good note for Lanka and a much-needed good over for them.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to cover.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one more.
Lovely shot but only for one! On middle, this is swept through square leg for one.
On off, Mendis pushes it to covers.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Had that been taken cleanly, there could have been another wicket! Shorter and outside off, this is cut to point. The batters go for one and the misfield makes the single easy.
One! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Excellent fielding! Australia have their tails up here! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled but the fielder at mid-wicket dives to his right and stops it well.
Flatter and on off, Mendis guides it to point.
Shorter and on off, this is guided to point. Australia squeezing now. Not allowing singles too.
Flatter and on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
BEATEN! Lovely end to a brilliant over for the Ausses! Angled across the off pole. Charith Asalanka plays inside the line and is beaten.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a stunner. Agar can't believe he has taken that. Just Warner things! He has plucked that out of thin air. Outstanding. Dhananjaya de Silva looks to break the shackles. He steps out, gets a little too close to the pitch of the ball but tries to lift it over mid on. He does hit it decently but Warner there runs to his right, leans, sticks one hand out and it stays in. Three wickets in quick succession for the visitors and they are bag into the game big time. Also, Charith Asalanka walks out to bat now.
Commentary.Howout: c David Warner b Ashton Agar

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter, on middle, slower. This one holds in the surface. it is pushec back to the bowler.
That is wonderful bowling! Slower and it lands on middle, it lands and then spins away. Dhananjaya de Silva looks to defend but it goes off the outer half and on the bounce to slip.
Shorter and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Slower and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Tidy end to Stoinis' first over. On a good length, around off. Mendis hangs back and taps it towards cover-point.
Around the hips, this is pulled away behind square on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length, around off. This is played late and towards backward point.
Stoinis keeps it close to the off pole and de Silva just pushes it towards the cover region.
Good-length, around the top of off. De Silva taps it towards backward point.
Starts off with a length ball, outside off. Dhananjaya de Silva hangs back and steers it to the right of third man and collects a couple of runs.
Flighted a bit, around off. Mendis drives but can't get it through covers.
A tad shorter, around off, this is punched through covers for a run.
Flatter and quicker, on off. This is kept out by Dhananjaya de Silva.
Shorter in length and outside off, this is tapped away towards deep cover for one.
On a length and sliding onto the pads, this is worked away off the back foot past square leg for a couple of runs.
This is angled into the pads, Mendis makes a bit of room looking to drive but misses.
Good length and on off, kept out.

NOT OUT! Dhananjaya de Silva was in but by just! Good run in the end! Length and on off, this is dropped to the left of the bowler. They go for one. Josh gets to the ball, picks it up and has a shy at the keeper's end. He hits the stumps. It is taken upstairs. Stoinis at deep square leg feels it is out again but time Dhananjaya de Silva is in.
FOUR! Timed brilliantly and this will release a little bit of pressure! Shorter and on off, Mendis guides it past point and this one races away to the fence.
Lovely shot to get off the mark! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Timed well! Fuller and on off, this is creamed back towards the bowler who does well to stop it.
Length, on off. This is kept out by de Silva.
A tad bit short and wide, tapped being point for a single.
Flatter and around off, kept out by de Silva.
Dhananjaya de Silva walks out to bat now!

OUT! CAUGHT! How often have we seen it? One wicket brings two and that is exactly what has happened here. Ashton Agar just angles it in on a length and into middle. Seeing Mendis struggle a bit at the other end, Pathum Nissanka feels he has to take a risk and it doesn't come off. Nissanka attempts the reverse sweep and hits it straight to Aaron Finch at short third man who takes a simple catch. Both set-batters are dismissed now and Australia will look to pile on the pressure.
Commentary.Howout: c Aaron Finch b Ashton Agar

Commentary.Commentary: This is speared in at the toes, Nissanka uses his feet and jams it out towards the bowler.
Flatter and outside off, Mendis cuts it through cover and picks up a run.
Nicely flighted, full and around off. Mendis works it towards covers as Nissanka looks for one but is sent back.
This is angled into middle and off, Mendis pushes it out towards cover and picks up a quick single.
Well left! Bowled into the channel around off and just shaping in a touch. Kusal Mendis shoulders arms at it.
Around off, solidly blocked off this time by Mendis.

How close was that to the off stump? Josh Hazlewood serves a lovely length ball, on off and the ball keeps low a bit. Mendis looks to play at it with an angled bat but is beaten and the ball just shaves the top of off.
Nicely bowled! Length, on off and the ball just tails back in a touch. Mendis hangs back and just about manages to keep it out.
Around the top of off, Nissanka stays inside the crease and dabs it down towards third man for a single.
Flatter delivery, around off. Mendis works it off the back foot towards cover-point.
On a length, slower through the air and angling into off. Kusal Mendis defends it off the front foot.

OUT! RUN OUT! An error in judgment and the partnership is finally broken! Full and straight, Danushka Gunathilaka with a sweetly timed sweep shot to the left of Marcus Stoinis at deep mid-wicket. Stoinis is quick to get to the ball but has to dive for it. Seeing this, the batters push for two but Stoinis fires in a bullet throw towards Alex Carey who whips off the bails in a flash. The replay shows that even the desperate dive couldn't save Gunathilaka and Australia have the breakthrough they needed. A fine knock from Gunathilaka though.
Run out appeal! It is taken upstairs. This could be really close. Stoinis feels it is out.
Quicker delivery, angled into middle. Nissanka pushes it through mid on for one.

FOUR! Poor delivery from Ashton Agar and Pathum Nissanka fulls advantage of it. With square leg inside the ring, Agar drifts onto the pads. Nissanka gets inside the line of the ball and sweeps it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Slower through the air and pushed across the off pole, Gunathilaka pushes it out with soft hands towards cover for a quick single.
Sweetly driven but straight to the man! Floated up, around off, Pathum Nissanka cover-drives but can't get it through.
Around the top of off, nudged away towards mid-wicket.
On the pads, swung away through square leg for a run.

FOUR! Muscled and Danushka Gunathilaka also brings up his FIFTY! Good-length, over leg stump, Gunathilaka backs away and hammers it back past the bowler for a boundary. It's been an aggressive knock from Gunathilaka.
FIFTY up for Pathum Nissanka and the young man shows promise once again. Around the top of off, nicely guided past backward point for one.
Length ball, on the pads. Gunathilaka tucks it easily off his legs and towards deep backward square leg for a single.
This is floated up, full and around off. Nissanka pushes it towards covers.

Gets beaten in flight but manages to get it away. Agar bowls it really slow and pulls back the length, around off. Danushka Gunathilaka gives the charge but the ball turns in and he heaves it off the inner half of the bat towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and around off, Nissanka taps it through covers for a single and the 100 is up for Sri Lanka.
On a length and angled into off, Nissanka blocks it out.
Really slow through the air and on a length, sliding onto the pads. Gunathilaka looks to sweep but gets it off the gloves and the ball loops over the keeper. They get a single.
A slight fumble and an extra run is given away! On the pads, swept away pretty hard towards deep square leg. The fielder over there fumbles a bit and the batters get aa couple of runs.

DRINKS! Sri Lanka could not have asked for a better start! They are well on course to post a big score here. Their openers have looked brilliant and are batting very smartly. More of the same is what they will want. Australia on the other hand, seem frustrated and quite unhappy with how they have played so far. They need someone to step up and produce the goods. Will there be a hero for them?
On the pads, tucked away leg side for one more.
Shortens the length and bowls it around off. Nissanka pats it towards wide mid on for a single.
Flatter delivery, around off. Kept out by Nissanka.
Leg bye! Drifted onto the pads, Gunathilaka looks to sweep but gets it off the pads towards backward square leg for a leg bye.
WIDE! Good take from Carey behind the sticks. This is angled down leg and a wide is called.
Flatter and around off, Gunathilaka punches it off the back foot towards cover.
Gunathilaka looks to use his feet but Maxwell pulls back his length and bowls it quicker. Gunathilaka keeps it out.

Leg bye! Half an appeal but it is going down leg! On middle, Danushka Gunathilaka looks to play the reverse sweep but misses. It hits the flap of the pad and goes towards square leg. A single taken. That is missing leg. Leg bye.
In the air... safe! On middle, Pathum Nissanka sweeps, it goes more off the top edge but on the bounce to deep square leg. One taken.
On middle, Pathum Nissanka pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through coves for one.
Slower and around off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Misfield by Warner! Danushka Gunathilaka steps out and gets to the pitch of it. He slams it to mid off where Warner misfields, a run is taken.
FOUR! Swept away! Glenn Maxwell fires it down the leg side, Pathum Nissanka is quick to get down and sweeps it hard and low past short fine leg for a boundary. A very strong start this by the hosts.
On off, driven towards long off by Gunathilaka for one more.
Around off, this is just eased through cover-point for a run.
Turning in from off stump, Nissanka gets low and attempts the reverse sweep. Nissanka connects but can't beat the man at short third man.
Maxwell switches to around the wicket and floats it up around middle. Gunathilaka leans forward and pushes it towards mid-wicket for a quick single.
Maxwell drags it down a bit, outside off. Nissanka waits for it and taps it past point for a single.

NOT OUT! The sound was of the bat hitting the pad! Shorter and around off, Danushka Gunathilaka looks to cut but is beaten. There is a sound as the ball passes the bat. An appeal from Carey after taking it. It is referred as the umpire shakes his head. Replays show that the ball is away from the bat. Australia lose a review.

A huge appeal from the bowler and the keeper as Aaron Finch does opt for a review for a caught-behind decision. On first look, there is a sound but it seems to be the bat hitting the pad. UltraEdge shows a spike but not when the ball passes the bat and hence the on-field decision of NOT OUT stands. Australia lose a review as well.
Slower through the air, lands it on off, Gunathilaka looks to defend, it goes off the outer half to point.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
On middle, this is worked down to long on for one.
FOUR! Swept and done so brilliantly! On the pads, this is swept behind square on the leg side. The ball races away to the fence.
On off, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Just a slight delay in play as the physio comes out to strap Pathum Nissanka's left arm a bit. Nissanka seemed to be struggling a bit but is fine now.
Quick run and the batter makes it in! On middle, this is worked to mid on. The batter goes for it. The fielder picks the ball up and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
On middle, kept out.

FOUR OVERTHROWS! Bonus runs! Not sure why the fielder had a shy there! Length and on off, this is pushed towards cover. Agar has a needless shy at the bowler's end. No one backing up and it goes to the fence.
On the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
Outside off, Pathum Nissanka guides it down to third man for one.
On off, DG plays it with soft hands towards cover and takes one. Really good batting.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler. 6 from Agar's first.
FOUR! Up and over! Short and on middle, Pathum Nissanka rocks back and pulls it over the mid-wicket fielder and into the gap for a boundary.
Slightly shorter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Confusion but the single is taken in the end! On off, Pathum Nissanka pushes it towards cover. He takes off. Gunathilaka waits for it to beat the fielder and then goes for it.
Slows it up this time and bowls it on off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Angled into the pads, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Ashton Agar is brought into the attack now.
Half a stop and a single is taken in the end! Fuller and on off, Pathum Nissanka pushes it towards cover. The fielder dives to his left and makes a half stop. A run in the end.
Shorter and on off, Pathum Nissanka pushes it to covers.
Length and on middle, this is pushed to mid on.
Around off, this is guided to point.
On off, Danushka Gunathilaka drops it towards cover and takes one.
Slashes but misses! Lengtn and outside off, once again, extra bounce. Danushka Gunathilaka looks to cut but is beaten.
Powerplay 1 is done! The fielding side can now have a maximum of four fielders outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
FOUR! Put away! 14 from the over and this is the perfect end to Powerplay 1 for the Lankans. They are cruising along here. Shorter and outside off, Nissanka cuts it through point for a boundary.
On off, this is pushed to covers.

SIX! That has hit the cushion on the full! 10 runs from the over now. 50 up and in quick time! Shorter and on the body, Pathum Nissanka looks to pull, this goes off the top edge and towards the fine leg fence for a biggie.
Around off, this is guided to point.
On off, this is blocked towards cover.
FOUR! Put away! Lovely shot! Shorter and outside off, Pathum Nissanka throws his bat at it, it goes through point for a boundary. This is a really good start for Lanka.
A dot to end. Good-length, over off stump. Gunathilaka steers it towards backward point.
Length this time, around leg, Gunathilaka pushes it towards mid on.

FOUR! Well struck! Overpitched, around off. Gunathilaka just hits through the line of the ball and holds the pose as the ball flies past the man at mid on for another boundary. This is a good start for the hosts so far.
Fullish delivery, on leg stump and bowled at 140 clicks. Gunathilaka drives it towards mid off.
Early call and done with ease in the end. Full and straight, driven without much timing to the left of mid on for a quick single.
This is pitched up on off stump, Pathum Nissanka punches it off the front foot past a diving cover fielder for a couple of runs.
A slower one to end. On off, Danushka Gunathilaka looks to cut but is beaten by the tennis ball like bounce.
On off, kept out again.
Two more! Length and on off, this is hit hard into the ground, it goes over point and two is taken.
On off, a slower one, Gunathilaka guides it to point.
FOUR! Lovely shot from Danushka Gunathilaka! That is hit strength. The pick-up shot! Angled into the pads, Danushka Gunathilaka whips it over the square leg fielder for a boundary.

A slight cofusion but a single in the end! A slower one on middle, Pathum Nissanka looks to pull but misses. He is again early in the shot. It hits him on the pad and rolls on the leg side. A run taken.
On off, kept out. A really good comeback after going for a boundary on the very first ball.
Another one on the stumps, Gunathilaka plays it to covers.
On the off pole, this is kept out well.
On the pads, Danushka Gunathilaka flicks but to mid-wicket.
Beauty! Length and on off, thislands and moves away. Danushka Gunathilaka is beaten as he tries to defend.

FOUR! EDGY FOUR! Also a misfield! Good start by Richardson but runs to the batter. A welcome boundary for Lanka! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Danushka Gunathilaka tries to defend, it goes off the otuside edge between the legs of widish first slip and down to the third man fence. That probably bounced just in front of Finch and hence, he failed to stop it.
Jhye Richardson to have a bowl now.
Short and outside off, Pat Cummins hops and guides it to point. The fielder dives to his right and makes a very good stop.
Good length and on off, Nissanka plays it to covers.
WIDE! That is a wayward ball! Short and down the leg side, Nissanka looks to pull but misses. Wided.

What a delivery that is! Pathum Nissanka had no clue about it. Cummins probably sees Pathum comes down the track. He bowls a lovely slower one. Nissanka is way too early in his shot. He misses, it goes over the stumps.
Back of a length and on off, Pathum Nissanka stays back and defends.
Really well bowled! Length, around off, this one jags back in. Nissanka works it to mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
A dot to end but a good over for Sri Lanka! Length and on off, this is guided to point.
Now takes one as this is worked with the angle through square leg. Good sensible batting.
FOUR! THUMPED AWAY! That has been pulled with disdain! Shorter in length and on middle, Danushka Gunathilaka hangs back and slams it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
That one stays quite low. Length and outside of, Danushka Gunathilaka looks to defend but this one goes under the bat and dies at it gets to the keeper.

Extra bounce but really well played! Length and on off, this one takes off after landing. Danushka Gunathilaka plays it really well, gets on top of the bounce and guides it fine on the off side. Cummins at third man, runs to his right, slides, he though fails to pick the ball cleanly but stops it from touching the ropes. Two taken.
A maiden to begin with then by Pat Cummins! On a length to end and on off, Nissanka blocks it out.
Slashes but misses! Extra bounce on that. It was the effort ball. Shorter and outside off, Nissanka throws his bat at it, he is beaten as there is extra bounce.
Good length again and on off, Nissanka pushes it to covers.
Nissanka will feel he missed out there! Angled into the pads, Pathum Nissanka looks to flick but it hits the pad and rolls on the leg side.
Back of a length and on off, a seam up ball this time, it is pushed to covers.
A slower one to begin with, fuller and on off, Nissanka works it to mid on.
Just the one trial over from Glenn Maxwell and Pat Cummins is now into the attack.
Around the hips, tucked away behind square on the leg side for a single.
Hazlewood just pulls back the length a touch and angles it into the body. Nissanka hangs back and keeps it out.
Length ball, on middle. Nissanka gets behind the line of the ball to make the block.
Around the top of off and just nipping back in a touch. Nissanka looks to cut but mistimes it back onto the deck.
Good-length, over middle. Gunathilaka stays deep in his crease and watches it all the way through before just guiding it down towards third man for a run.
Good running. Back of a length, over middle. Pathum Nissanka hops and dabs it down towards square leg for a quick single.
Angled into middle and leg, Gunathilaka keeps it out.
FOUR! Too short from Maxwell and he is punished. Around off, Gunathilaka rocks back and slaps it into the vacant point fence.
Around middle and leg, Nissanka with a tickle around the corner for a quick single.
Slightly flighted, around off. Nissanka turns it towards mid-wicket.
WIDE! Maxwell pulls back the length and spills it down the leg side, wide called.
Tossed up, around off. Gunathilaka with a nicely-timed drive through mid off for a single.
Starts off with a floater, angled into the pads. Gunathilaka pushes it out on the off side.
Glenn Maxwell to take the other new ball.
On a good length, around off. Pathum Nissanka just guides it towards backward point. Five runs off the first over.
There's variable bounce right from the first over. Length, outside off and this one just dies on its way to the keeper.
A touch fuller, on the fourth stump line, Nissanka pushes it outy towards covers.

FOUR! Streaky! Length, around off and this one keeps a bit low. Nissanka has a go at it but gets a bottom edge past the stumps and Alex Carey is unable to stop it. The ball runs away into the fence and Nissanka is off the mark with a boundary.
Length again, in that channel around off. Pathum Nissanka stays on the back foot and nudges it down towards the gully region.
Off the mark straightaway! Josh Hazlewood starts off with a length ball, around the top of off. Danushka Gunathilaka hangs back and steers it past backward point for a single.

Done with the pre-game formalities! The play is about to begin as the umpires and the players make their way out to the middle. Pathum Nissanka and Danushka Gunathilaka are set to open the innings for Sri Lanka. Josh Hazlewood has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...

We are minutes away from the start of play. But first, the two sets of players line up for their respective national anthems. It will be Australia's national anthem first followed by the national anthem of Sri Lanka.

Aaron Finch captain of Australia informs Alex Carey, Marcus Stoinis and Pat Cummins come in, adds there have been a couple of unfortunate changes due to injuries. Finch ends by saying they would have batted first but he backs his side to chase down anything later on.

Sri Lanka skipper, Dasun Shanaka says it is a used wicket and there might be some assistance for the spinners later on. Shanaka says they need to do more in the middle order and they have had a serious chat about their batting and he hopes they can do well. Informs they have a debutant in the form of Dunith Wellalage and Dhananjaya de Silva also comes in.

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold is pitchside. Arnold says it is the same pitch on which 176 was chased down. Adds it should be a good one to bat on. Mentions it seems dry and maybe on the slower side. Reckons there might be turn as we saw in the last game played here but it should not be a hard wicket to bat on. Ends by saying 250-260 should be par.
Australia (Playing XI) - David Warner, Aaron Finch (C), Steven Smith, Marnus Labuschagne, Marcus Stoinis, Glenn Maxwell, Alex Carey (WK), Ashton Agar, Pat Cummins, Jhye Richardson and Josh Hazlewood.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Danushka Gunathilaka, Pathum Nissanka, Kusal Mendis (WK), Charith Asalanka, Dhananjaya de Silva, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Chamika Karunaratne, Dushmantha Chameera, Maheesh Theekshana and Dunith Wellalage (On ODI debut).
TOSS - Sri Lanka have won the toss and they will have a BAT first.

The hosts were pretty poor with the bat in the T20I series but that last game will give them hope that they can go up against a world class bowling unit. Still they will have to be patient and maximize their chances if they are to take a lead in this series. So, one of the few times in recent history that we see a five-match ODI series. Who will start off on the right foot? We'll find out. Toss and team news in a bit.
